headline: Week 18: The Meaningless Mile — Where Trophies Don't Live But Egos Still Die
subhead: No matchups, no playoffs, no trophies — just T Swift's Baddies dropping 156 in a fantasy ghost town while 226 Alpha submitted a 33-piece nugget meal.
matchOfTheWeek: There were literally zero matchups this week, which somehow still produced a clearer winner and loser than half the league's regular season games. T Swift's Baddies vs. The Void was the real Game of the Week — Gibbs going for 46 and Drake London adding 40.7 in a contest that mattered to no one but Tnicolle's group chat. Meanwhile 226 Alpha posted a 33.10 in a week where you could've started a corpse and gotten 60.
powerRankingsShakeup: Power rankings don't move in Week 18, but vibes do — and the vibe is that half this league forgot to set a lineup while T Swift's Baddies was out here cooking like the playoffs were still on.
mainRecap:
Welcome to Week 18, the fantasy football equivalent of clapping after the credits roll. Nothing counted, nobody was watching, and somehow people still found ways to embarrass themselves.

Let's start with Bo Nix Celli, who managed to score 131 points and STILL leave 70.66 on the bench. That's a 65% efficiency rating in a week where the only thing being graded is whether you remembered Yahoo exists. Michael Penix dropped 25.98 from the pine, Dameon Pierce added another 23.60, and Nick is out here playing 4D chess with players who weren't even on his active roster. Bijan went for 31.30 and Herbert dropped 28 — and you still managed to lineup-malpractice your way to a participation trophy.

The Good Ladds had Bryce Young — BRYCE YOUNG — drop 36.44 on the bench. Bryce Young hasn't been worth 36 fantasy points in his entire NFL career combined and Mig benched the one week it happened. Kyler did his job with 27.88, but Bryce was sitting there glowing like a radioactive isotope and nobody noticed.

Stroud Boys gets a special shoutout for benching Miles Sanders (26.60) AND Kayshon Boutte (24.70) in the same week. That's a 51-point bench combo from two guys whose names you probably can't pick out of a lineup. Bjewett, what are you doing.

226 Alpha posted 33.10. Thirty. Three. Point. One. Zero. Szara, brother — even the bye-week zombies put up 60. Did you start six TEs and a kicker from 2019?

LargestofRocks got 31.60 from Quentin Johnston of all people, Hot Cocks rode Jakobi Meyers to 27.30, and Put an AR to My Head somehow extracted 26.50 from Pat Freiermuth in a meaningless week. The most chaotic outcomes from the most chaotic week.

Jets' Juniors hit 91.4% lineup efficiency in a week that didn't matter. Mattwunder, you're the kid who shows up to the cancelled exam with two sharpened pencils.

weeklyAwards.title: King of Nothing
weeklyAwards.blurb: 156.80 in a week with zero matchups — the loudest tree falling in the emptiest forest.

weeklyAwards.title: The Bench Coach Award
weeklyAwards.blurb: Left 70.66 on the bench, including a Penix-Pierce combo that would've won any actual matchup.

weeklyAwards.title: Bryce Young Truther of the Year
weeklyAwards.blurb: Benched a 36-burger from a QB who's averaged negative-three points in his career — historic timing.

weeklyAwards.title: Did You Even Log In?
weeklyAwards.blurb: 33.10 points. A high school JV kicker could've outscored your entire active roster.
